description: OrcaSlicer lithophane print-settings template for a Creality K1 Max (0.4 mm nozzle). Open orcaslicer-lithophane-settings.3mf in OrcaSlicer, delete the placeholder object, import a lithophane STL, leave it flat with the back down, and slice with the project/Global settings.
orientation: Print flat with the back down (relief facing up).
notes: Official OrcaSlicer process profiles spell the printer as 'K1Max' (no space) in the process name, and 'K1 Max' in the printer name.
Physical fit of photo lithophanes in the lantern is untested.
Printing vertically can give a better-looking image but may change the frame thickness by about 0.05–0.1 mm.
Complete flattened project settings are stored inside the 3MF at Metadata/project_settings.config.
